artConfig.title: Threshold token art
artConfig.lead: The token wears the lowest band the watched resource has fallen to, and its own art above them all.
artConfig.enabled: Enable threshold art for this actor
artConfig.unreadable: Nothing readable at that path on this actor.
artConfig.noBands: Threshold art is enabled but has no complete bands. Give each band a threshold and an image, or disable it.
artConfig.saved: Threshold art saved for {name} - {tokens} on {scenes} will wear it.
artConfig.savedNone: Threshold art saved for {name} - none of its tokens are placed yet, so the change shows the moment one is.
artConfig.savedOff: Threshold art saved for {name} - it is switched off, so its tokens keep their own art.

artSummary.hint: Swap this creature's token art as a watched resource falls - bloodied at half, broken at a quarter, and so on.

inspect.nothingKnown: Nothing is known about this creature yet.
inspect.acHowTo: Narrows with every attack that lands or misses.
inspect.hpHowTo: Estimated once one has been bloodied or felled.

migration.carried: Interactable Actors carried {actors} creature(s) and {tokens} token(s) across the module's rename.

reveal.acPinned: The players have pinned {name}'s armour class at {ac}.

contextMenu.name: Player Right-Click Menu
contextMenu.hint: Enables / Disables the right-click menu players use to inspect tokens. While GS: Quality of Life is enabled this setting does nothing and is instead handled in GS: Quality of Life.

revealOnDamage.name: Defence Auto-Reveal
revealOnDamage.hint: Enables / Disables automatically revealing to players each resistance, immunity or vulnerability that changes the damage applied to a creature.

observeCombat.name: Armour and Health Estimates
observeCombat.hint: Enables / Disables the Inspect window estimating an NPC's Armour Class and Hit Points from attacks against it and the damage it takes. Attacks count only when rolled publicly with the NPC targeted.

announceReveals.name: GM Reveal Whispers
announceReveals.hint: Enables / Disables a whisper to the GM when damage reveals a defence or when attacks pin down an NPC's Armour Class.

chatDescriptions.name: Chat Descriptions
chatDescriptions.hint: Enables / Disables the Inspect window showing an ability's or spell's chat description, if it has one, instead of its full description. Hovering its name can still show the full description.
